name: Red Star Macalline Group Corporation Ltd.
summary: Red Star Macalline Group Corporation Ltd. operates and manages home improvement and furnishing malls in the People's Republic of China. It operates through four segments: Owned/Leased Portfolio Shopping Malls; Managed Shopping Malls; Construction and decoration service; and Others. The company leases floor areas of shopping malls; operates as a construction contractor to develop and manage the shopping malls; and retails home furnishing merchandise, as well as offers related decorating services.
